about_the_game:
In Blind Spot you play as a special agent and your goal is to contain an entity that lives inside a residential house. A family also lives inside this house and they are vulnerable to possession. It is not recommend by the agency to enter the house. The agency has allowed you a camera feed into the house and special machines that will allow you to contain the threat in relative safety. If you find yourself in the likely situation where a family member escapes, then the agency recommends that you watch your back.

Secure The House:

In addition to cameras many other machines have been made available for your use. A nulifier has been provided and can be used to dispel paranormal events, there will also be a mannequin that can be used to trick the family and lastly we have also provided a six pack of beer, under no circumstances can you drink this beer for refreshment or pleasure. You must also make sure all doors and windows are secured, the scissor lift can help you with windows that are too high to reach.

Observation:

With the cameras you will be able to see the family chill maxing in there domicile (usually sleeping). You must observe them for any anomalies, members of the family (even with prior notice not to) will try and escape the house. Family members may try to sabotage cameras and the agency has provided the beers to deal with this problem. The agency has authorized you to drink one of the beers and go inside to fix the defunct camera. The effects of alcohol will help cloak you from the thing that hides inside. If a family member some how makes it outside, it is imperative that you do not approach, your life may depend on it. 

Exploration:

All the surrounding streets and houses have been evacuated to limit civilian casualties and cover the whole scope of the operation. It is likely that the entity will sabotage the power grid to try and holt operations. If the grid is sabotage then you are permitted to go and fix the problem. Be advised many entities attracted to the house roam the streets, watch your back.

Seven Nights With Frendies:

There are seven nights that you are required to survive. No night is the same and each new night is more difficult than the night before. Additionally each new night introduces new challenges and unique monsters.

Squid Time:

I understand that you may be feeling a little apprehensive about taking on this task. You may even be saying to yourself "holy guacamole I'm probably going to die". But you don't need to worry about death. Advances in technology have allowed us to turn you into a squid if you happen to die. We can turn you back into a human later, but for the moment you'll have to hang tight. As a squid you can still help your team to a limited capacity and since your still on the clock, you'll have to get back to work.

Team Work:

There is a lot of work to be done and it is recommended to play online in a squad. There are many tasks you'll need to accomplish and you'll be able to split the load between your group. You can have for example one of your friends operating the cameras while the other runs around the house securing windows. You can also choose to play with nobody and the game will intelligently even the scales of difficulty to match.

  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 760 or AMD R9 270X
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection

  • Sound Card: DirectX®-compatible

short_description: Multiplayer co-op, survival horror game. Play with your friends as you monitor and secure a residental house that is haunted by an entity. Use cameras to keep sight on the family, you must stop them from escaping, watch your back and try to survive!
